The data here runs to 2026-03-27 — 78 days ago — so treat everything below as a picture of that moment, not today.

The sharpest miss cuts in your favour. You guessed ≈£0 as what you could set aside; the real figure was £1,254 — "worked out from what was left over, not from detected transfers." That's a £1,254 swing you weren't expecting. **Eating out** moved the other way: you guessed ≈£280, the real spend was £55, a £225 undershoot. Both misses point the same direction — the sketch was more cautious than reality. **Housing**, **subscriptions**, and **bills** are still ≈ estimates; the upload couldn't isolate them, so they stay unverified.

Your corrected position: trailing-3-month average income is ≈£2,897/mo (variable — it swings month to month), fixed costs are £63/mo, and free cash flow is £2,837/mo. The buffer needs £417/mo to reach £2,500 by 2026-12-13 from a standing start of £0. Your sketch implied you had nothing spare; the real free cash clears that pace by a wide margin.

Only 8 transactions sit behind this read across 83 days, so the pattern layer is thin. The habits half of the picture is now fillable — timing, what recurs, the shape of the months — but what those patterns *mean* to you is still missing.

That check took me from a sketch to your real numbers — I now know you about 72%, past the 70% a real month unlocks. The last stretch is what these patterns mean to you, and that's what the Value Map settles.

[CTA:start_value_map_real]Tell me what these mean[/CTA]

— C.
